system.description:
Limitations: Casting takes 5 minutes, during which the caster can't move. Only affects Mobs with an Intelligence of 2 or greater.

On a Standard Success, roughly 1 in 50 Mobs within the burst (minimum 1) permanently convert to your allies for the Spell's duration, without you needing to issue them commands. Higher degrees of success convert more Mobs, at the GM's discretion.

Note: this mass-conversion-to-ally mechanic with a success-tier ratio table has no structural support - resolve the conversion count by GM judgment.

upgrades.description: Casting time is reduced to 4 minutes, and the duration increases to 5 minutes.
The burst radius increases by your CHA score, and the duration increases to 10 minutes.
The burst radius increases by your CHA score again, and the duration increases to 15 minutes.
